title: KPN webinar recording available: expanding into a Biomedical Knowledge Portal Network
summary: View the recording of our webinar about the NIH Common Fund Data Ecosystem and the Knowledge Portal team's new role within it.
bodyHtml: In our February 8 KPN webinar we introduced a network of consortia doing groundbreaking research, the NIH Common Fund Data Ecosystem (CFDE), and described our new role as the CFDE Knowledge Center.
